title: Monitoring Models in Production with SageMaker Model Monitor [Hands-On]

cues.en: Hello my friends and welcome to this, your hands-on tutorial on how to monitor models in production with SageMaker Model Monitor.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到使用 SageMaker Model Monitor 監控正式環境模型的實作。

cues.en: All right, so I already prepared everything for you.
cues.zh: 已經準備好全部。

cues.en: Please do not reproduce this tutorial because not only SageMaker is a very expensive service, but besides, having a model in production in the form of an endpoint is even more expensive.
cues.zh: 請不要重做，SageMaker 貴，模型部署為端點更貴。

cues.en: So I would recommend only watching this tutorial and therefore, I already prepared everything.
cues.zh: 建議只觀看，所以先準備好。

cues.en: I created the SageMaker domain, then I created a dummy machine learning model, which then I deployed in the form of an endpoint because you will actually see
cues.zh: 建網域、假模型，再部署端點，因為會看到

cues.en: that SageMaker model monitor can be seen in two places, first, in your SageMaker dashboard, but then more precisely and more usefully, you can see it in action
cues.zh: Model Monitor 有兩個查看位置，SageMaker 儀表板，以及更精確實用的

cues.en: inside your endpoint dashboard, okay?
cues.zh: 端點儀表板。

cues.en: So that's exactly what I'm gonna show you in this tutorial.
cues.zh: 這堂就展示。

cues.en: And so there we go.
cues.zh: 開始。

cues.en: Let's go to our Amazon SageMaker AI console.
cues.zh: 到 SageMaker AI 主控台。

cues.en: Alright, so welcome back to Amazon SageMaker AI.
cues.zh: 歡迎回來。

cues.en: And so, as I was just telling you, the first way to find SageMaker model monitor in action because you know, SageMaker model monitor is not like a tangible feature.
cues.zh: 第一個位置，因為 Model Monitor 不是像一個實體可點的獨立功能，

cues.en: Like for example, model cards that we saw before.
cues.zh: 例如之前的 Model cards。

cues.en: It rather happens in the backend, but you can see it happening or you know, working for you in two different places.
cues.zh: 而是在後端運作，可在兩處看到。

cues.en: So the first place is, indeed, the SageMaker AI dashboard, which is a new feature by the way.
cues.zh: 第一是 SageMaker AI Dashboard，也是新功能。

cues.en: And actually, that's where I am, if you started from here, you know, at the main creation, while the way to find the dashboard is to just click below here dashboard
cues.zh: 我目前就在這裡，若從服務首頁開始，按下方 Dashboard，

cues.en: and you will find SageMaker model monitoring right here, model monitoring.
cues.zh: 這裡就有 Model monitoring。

cues.en: And so as you can see here, it basically says how many models you have that are active.
cues.zh: 顯示多少個作用中模型。

cues.en: So right now, I have one active model.
cues.zh: 現在一個。

cues.en: Active means that I deployed it.
cues.zh: Active 表示已部署。

cues.en: You know, after creating it, I deployed it in the form of an endpoint.
cues.zh: 建立後部署為端點。

cues.en: That's what active means here, as pointed out by model monitoring, okay?
cues.zh: 這裡的 Active 就是如此。

cues.en: And model monitoring also tells you if you have any active model card.
cues.zh: 也告訴你有沒有作用中的模型卡。

cues.en: And we created model cards before in the previous sections.
cues.zh: 前面做過模型卡。

cues.en: Okay, so that's the basic model monitoring.
cues.zh: 這是基本監控。

cues.en: But then there is the more advanced and more detailed SageMaker model monitoring, which happens at the endpoint level.
cues.zh: 更進階、詳細的，則在端點層級。

cues.en: So right now, we're gonna go to the left hand panel.
cues.zh: 到左側。

cues.en: We're gonna scroll down.
cues.zh: 往下。

cues.en: First, I'm gonna show you that, indeed, I created a new model.
cues.zh: 先展示確實建新模型。

cues.en: If I go to my models here, I created this new model, which is a dummy model.
cues.zh: Models 內有新假模型。

cues.en: You know, it's not trained on any data.
cues.zh: 沒有用任何資料訓練。

cues.en: It's just a model I created by actually clicking this create model and then, you know, entering the different settings and configurations after which I, indeed, selected my model here
cues.zh: 只是按 Create model、輸入設定，再選模型，

cues.en: and then created the endpoint, okay?
cues.zh: 建立端點。

cues.en: Entering in some more configurations and then created the endpoint.
cues.zh: 再設一些參數後建端點。

cues.en: So that's what I did.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: So I have my model here.
cues.zh: 模型在這裡。

cues.en: You won't find any model monitoring inside your model, just some information about the container, network, et cetera.
cues.zh: 模型頁不會找到監控，只有容器、網路等資訊。

cues.en: But SageMaker model monitoring will happen at the endpoint level, okay?
cues.zh: 監控在端點層級。

cues.en: So if you go to your endpoints after deploying your model, well there you go.
cues.zh: 部署後到 Endpoints，

cues.en: You will find this endpoint of the machinery model I just showed you and created before.
cues.zh: 找到剛建立、展示的模型端點。

cues.en: As you can see, it is in service.
cues.zh: 狀態 In service。

cues.en: And indeed because it is now in service and running, you can monitor it because remember that SageMaker Model monitoring is all about monitoring your models in production,
cues.zh: 正在服務、執行，就能監控，記得它監控正式環境模型，

cues.en: and that's exactly what an endpoint is about.
cues.zh: 這正是端點的用途。

cues.en: You know, it's your machinery model in production and therefore, you will find SageMaker model monitoring inside your endpoint right here in this Monitor tab.
cues.zh: 正式模型在端點內，可在 Monitor 分頁看。

cues.en: This is really where SageMaker model monitoring is in action because it'll give you the different operational metrics of your machinery model in production, such
cues.zh: 講者稱這就是模型監控運作的位置，提供維運指標，

cues.en: as the CPU utilization, okay, with the percentage of CPU utilized over time, but also the memory utilization and the disc utilization,
cues.zh: 例如 CPU 使用率隨時間變化、記憶體、磁碟使用率，

cues.en: the GPU utilization if you're using a GPU, and the GPU memory utilization, once again if you are using A GPU, okay?
cues.zh: 有 GPU 則 GPU 與 GPU 記憶體使用率。

cues.en: And then you have the invocation metrics whenever your machinery model is invoked to make predictions, for example.
cues.zh: 也有模型呼叫預測的 Invocation metrics。

cues.en: And then in vocational errors, if any errors occur, and model latency.
cues.zh: Invocation errors，以及 Model latency。

cues.en: So you see, this is actually quite important for the exam.
cues.zh: 考試很重要。

cues.en: You know to understand what SageMaker model monitoring actually monitors for you, you know, for your model in production.
cues.zh: 理解模型監控實際監控哪些內容。

cues.en: And so there you go, that's SageMaker Model Monitor.
cues.zh: 這就是 SageMaker Model Monitor 的示範。

cues.en: Now you know how to find it, you know how to use it.
cues.zh: 知道怎麼找、怎麼用。

cues.en: Remember that it's used at the endpoint level simply because it monitors your models in production.
cues.zh: 記得在端點層級，因為監控正式環境模型。

cues.en: And so with that in mind, you should be totally fine to answer correctly, SageMaker model monitor questions and use cases at the exam.
cues.zh: 有這些概念，就能回答相關考題與案例。

cues.en: Alright, so that's it for SageMaker Model Monitor.
cues.zh: 教學到此。

cues.en: I look forward to seeing you in the next hands-on tutorial.
cues.zh: 期待下一堂實作。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning with AWS.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受 AWS 機器學習的樂趣吧。
